ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels to 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white region across both lobes. High-contrast black pigmentation is mapped to the trailing edge perimeter, the distal tips, and a large, irregular triangular patch extending from the median notch toward the peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees and a vertical depth roughly equal to the opening width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; frequency of approximately one peak every 15-20 horizontal pixels with vertical amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a convex sweep trajectory that tapers to sharp, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered across the white surface, with a notable concentration in the medial section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-vertical dark linear streaks on the left lobe (approx. 40-60 pixels in length) and several shorter, diagonal disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation/notch is visible on the distal leading edge of the left lobe; trailing edge shows multiple points of irregular material loss particularly on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct 'butterfly' shaped black-to-white transition boundary located at the central hinge area near the median notch.
